name: e2e
description: End-to-end test agent skills, grafted from sonhyrd/e2e-skills as an editable git subtree. pw-prove: prove a PR/branch/ticket/diff with a Playwright E2E test, fast. e2e-reviewer: static review of Playwright/Cypress specs and Page Objects, catching tests that pass CI but prove nothing. Both are user-invocable only; the subtree's three other skills ship as files but are not declared.
